theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_biLipschitz_image_measure_facts
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → Bornology.IsBounded B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → 0 < c → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → NullMeasurableSet (ψ '' B) μHE[n] ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (ψ '' B) ∧ μHE[n] (ψ '' B) < ∞ ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ ψ '' B, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[n] (ψ '' B ∩ Metric.closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) ∧ ∀ Z : Set (Rn N), μHE[n] Z = 0 → volume (B ∩ ψ ⁻¹' Z) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
